title: P10: the checkpoint model of the host RSpace (Checkpoint.v, the successor of the legacy Checkpoint.v, leaf rrs-fv-port-checkpoint). The items are the host code that writes the hot store into the history, resets the hot store to a root, takes and reverts a soft checkpoint, encodes the records of a key, applies the store steps of the space transaction, sweeps the volatile channels, and rigs a replay with the log of play.
design: P10 design v2 (.reified-rspaces-work/p10/design-v2.md), section 2.2, and plan decision 85. The headline ids are the ids of the P10 phase of formal/reified-rspaces-invariant-map.json.
code_base: The items are host code of the base 4d67b5ccc and the P1 substrate of this repository. The line numbers are informative. The checker finds each item by its scope and name.

K1.name: checkpoint_reset_restores_store
K1.statement: A reset at the root of a checkpoint gives a hot store whose record list of every key is a permutation of the list of the checkpointed hot store, with an empty cache that reads through to the new trie.

K2.name: checkpoint_restore_preserves_persist
K2.statement: A persistent datum of the checkpointed hot store is in the reset store with its flag, and a later COMM keeps it (the legacy defect D11 cannot occur).

K3.name: replay_from_equal_parent_states
K3.statement: Two hot stores with one cache whose record lists are permutations of each other stay so under the same operations, and their checkpoints and roots are equal.

K4.name: checkpoint_root_order_independent
K4.statement: The checkpoint of a hot store does not depend on the order of the records of a key, because each leaf is the sorted list of the encodings under a total order.

K5.name: rig_and_reset_replays_the_log
K5.statement: A replay rigged with the log of play and reset to the parent root accepts exactly that log, completes, and reaches the hot store of play.

K6.name: reset_after_sweep_drops_volatile
K6.statement: After the volatile sweep and the checkpoint, a reset store holds no data and no joins of a swept channel and no continuation of a swept group.

K7.name: soft_revert_after_prefix_failure
K7.statement: Every prefix of a deploy keeps the read-through to the base trie, and the revert of a soft checkpoint gives the cache and the values of the snapshot and the same checkpoint (decision 19 D6).

K8.name: chain_checkpoints_retrievable
K8.statement: Under collision resistance of the root, every root of a well-rooted history resets to a store that reads as the trie checkpointed under that root.

items.name: create_checkpoint
items.role: Writes the changes of the hot store into the history, then makes a new hot store over the new root.

items.name: reset
items.role: Resets the history to a root and makes a new hot store over the reader of that root.

items.name: create_soft_checkpoint
items.role: Takes the cache snapshot of the hot store (with the event log and the produce counter).

items.name: revert_to_soft_checkpoint
items.role: Makes a hot store from the cache snapshot over the base of the current history.

items.name: create_from_hs_and_hr
items.role: The hot store of a revert: the cached keys take the snapshot, the other keys read through to the base.

items.name: snapshot
items.role: The cache of the hot store, which a soft checkpoint keeps.

items.name: changes
items.role: One action for each cached key: a delete for an empty list, an insert of the records otherwise.

items.name: checkpoint
items.role: Applies the actions of the hot store to the radix tree and gives the new root.

items.name: reset
items.role: A history at a root of the content-addressed store.

items.name: encode_datums
items.role: The leaf of a data key: the bincode of each datum (its persistent flag included), sorted.

items.name: encode_continuations
items.role: The leaf of a continuation key: the bincode of each waiting continuation, sorted.

items.name: encode_joins
items.role: The leaf of a joins key: the bincode of each join group, sorted.

items.name: Datum
items.role: A stored datum; its persistent flag is a field of the record, so the encoding carries it.

items.name: store_data
items.role: The store step of a produce that stores its datum.

items.name: remove_matched_datum_and_join
items.role: The store step of a COMM: removes each matched record unless it is persistent, and the join entries of a group whose last waiter leaves.

items.name: store_waiting_continuation
items.role: The store step of a consume that parks: appends the waiter and adds its group to the joins of each channel.

items.name: sweep_volatile_channels
items.role: Clears the data, the joins and the continuations of the volatile channels and of their groups.

items.name: rig_and_reset
items.role: Resets the replay space to the parent root and rigs it with the log of play.

items.name: rig
items.role: Records the events of the log, which the replayed operations must meet.

items.name: check_replay_data
items.role: Fails when an event of the log was not met: the replay is complete.
